name: zabbix-ai-cli-mcp
description: Task-shaped Zabbix access for AI agents: problems, hosts, metrics, alerts and maintenance.
long_description: Asks Zabbix what is broken, why a host is silent and why an alert did not arrive, and can open a maintenance window when writes are allowed. Claude Desktop asks for the Zabbix URL and an API token; both are required. Allow writes is off unless you turn it on. The bundle is a single binary and does not need Node, Python or Go.

url.title: Zabbix URL
url.description: Base URL of the Zabbix frontend, for example https://zabbix.example.com

token.title: API token
token.description: Zabbix API token. Claude Desktop stores it as a secret and passes it only to this server.

allow_write.title: Allow writes
allow_write.description: Offer zabbix_write so a change can be applied in one call. Off leaves planning only.

tools.name: zabbix_alert_why
tools.description: Explain whether an event produced a notification, and what stood in the way.

tools.name: zabbix_api_call
tools.description: Call a Zabbix API method directly.

tools.name: zabbix_host_investigate
tools.description: Collect a diagnostic snapshot of one host in a single call.

tools.name: zabbix_host_status
tools.description: Summarise one host: availability, active problems, data freshness, maintenance.

tools.name: zabbix_hosts
tools.description: Find hosts by name fragment, pattern or group.

tools.name: zabbix_maintenance_list
tools.description: List maintenance windows, including expired ones.

tools.name: zabbix_metrics_history
tools.description: Read an item's values over a time window, with min, max and average.

tools.name: zabbix_metrics_latest
tools.description: Show the newest value of a host's items.

tools.name: zabbix_plan_create
tools.description: Describe a change to Zabbix without making it.

tools.name: zabbix_plan_status
tools.description: Check whether a stored plan is still waiting, was applied, or has expired.

tools.name: zabbix_problem
tools.description: Show one active problem by event identifier.

tools.name: zabbix_problems
tools.description: List active Zabbix problems, newest first.

tools.name: zabbix_resolve
tools.description: Turn the text of a notification into event, host and trigger identifiers.

tools.name: zabbix_unreachable
tools.description: List monitored hosts Zabbix currently cannot poll.

tools.name: zabbix_write
tools.description: Change Zabbix in one call and record it in the audit log.
